message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/opensc && ./configure --help | grep -i -C2 'piv\|sm' && grep -R "ENABLE_PIV_SM\|enable.*sm\|enable.*piv" -n configure.ac m4 src/libopensc/Makefile.am | head -100 && grep -n "PIV SM" config.log | tail -20` executed with exit code 0.

function.arguments: {"command":"cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/opensc && ./configure --help | grep -i -C2 'piv\\|sm' && grep -R \"ENABLE_PIV_SM\\|enable.*sm\\|enable.*piv\" -n configure.ac m4 src/libopensc/Makefile.am | head -100 && grep -n \"PIV SM\" config.log | tail -20"}
function.name: execute_bash

content:
--enable-ctapi          enable CT-API support [disabled]
  --enable-minidriver     enable minidriver on Windows [disabled]
  --disable-sm            disable secure messaging support and SM modules
                          [enabled]
  --enable-piv-sm         enable SM in PIV card driver linkage [disabled]
  --disable-man           disable installation of manuals [enabled for none
                          Windows]
configure.ac:259:       [enable_sm="yes"]
configure.ac:264:       [AS_HELP_STRING([--enable-piv-sm],[enable SM in PIV card driver linkage @<:@disabled@:>@])],
configure.ac:266:       [enable_piv_sm="no"]
configure.ac:864:if  test "${enable_piv_sm}" = "yes"; then
configure.ac:865:       AC_DEFINE([ENABLE_PIV_SM], [1], [Enable PIV SM])
configure.ac:970:if test "${enable_sm}" = "yes"; then
configure.ac:1146:AM_CONDITIONAL([ENABLE_SM], [test "${enable_sm}" = "yes"])
configure.ac:1247:SM support:              ${enable_sm}
configure.ac:1250:PIV SM support:          ${enable_piv_sm}

extras.command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/opensc && ./configure --help | grep -i -C2 'piv\|sm' && grep -R "ENABLE_PIV_SM\|enable.*sm\|enable.*piv" -n configure.ac m4 src/libopensc/Makefile.am | head -100 && grep -n "PIV SM" config.log | tail -20
